title: Deadly Israeli Strike on Gaza Raises Doubts About Trump Peace Plan
summary_full: A day after President Trump’s envoy, Jared Kushner, visited Israel to advance a stalled plan for demilitarizing and rebuilding Gaza, the Israeli military said it targeted Hamas commanders.
